subject: Supplier onboarding kickoff — scheduling, agenda, and PO checklist
messages:
From: Jamie Ellis <jamie.ellis@novacorp.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding kickoff — next steps and kickoff call

Hi Stephanie and team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at NovaCorp is ready to start vendor activation so we can issue POs against the pilot. Can we schedule a short kickoff to align on the intake checklist, PO process, and who owns each handoff on your side?

Key things we need to cover:
- Confirm legal/vendor name and tax docs (W-9)
- PO contact + billing email and invoice cadence
- Estimated onboarding timeline (test -> production) and milestone owners
- Any compliance evidence we should expect (SOC2, data flow diagram)

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 10/02 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Wed 10/03 09:00–09:30

If those don't work, happy to open our calendar. I can attach our standard onboarding intake form as well.

Best,
Jamie Ellis
Sourcing Manager, NovaCorp
procurement@novacorp.com
Attachment: novacorp_onboarding_form_v1.xlsx (stub)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Ellis <jamie.ellis@novacorp.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding kickoff — next steps and kickoff call

Hi Jamie — great to hear you're ready to kick off. Thanks for the windows; we can take Tue 10/02 14:00–14:30 PST. I've put a tentative hold on that slot and will send a calendar invite after you confirm.

Agenda I suggest (30m):
1) Introductions & scope (5m) — who on each side will be the day-to-day owners
2) PO & billing flow (8m) — Po creation, required fields, who signs, invoicing cadence
3) Onboarding checklist & docs (8m) — W-9, vendor contact, SOC2 evidence, network allowlist if needed
4) Timeline & success criteria (5m) — test pilot go-live target, acceptance criteria
5) Actions & owners (4m) — MAP items, deadlines

Pre-reads we need from NovaCorp before the call:
- Completed onboarding intake form (or basic vendor profile)
- W-9 or equivalent tax document
- Primary billing contact and billing email

On our side I will have Rishi (procurement operations) to walk PO mechanics and Laura (finance ops) to confirm invoicing and billing setup. We will also bring a simple MAP (mutual action plan) template to fill during the call.

Can you confirm the 14:00 PST slot and upload the W-9 to the Drive link below before the call? If you prefer a different time, propose and we can adjust.

Drive (upload here): https://drive.redwood.com/Novacorp/Onboarding-Checklist

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.

- Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Mobile: (415) 555-0123
Attachment: redwood_onboarding_map_v2.docx (stub)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Supplier onboarding kickoff — prep items for NovaCorp

Rishi / Laura — hooking you both in.

Quick notes for prep before 10/02 14:00 PST:
- Rishi: please be ready to explain PO lifecycle (how we ingest POs, required fields: vendor legal name, tax ID, deliverable code, billing email) and the expected SLA from procurement ops. Highlight any typical redlines we should flag so Jamie can prepare.
- Laura: confirm invoicing email and whether we require invoices to match PO numbers exactly (we do, but want to be explicit). Also confirm how we will set NovaCorp terms (Net30 vs. Net45) and the finance contact for vendor setup.

I'll have the MAP template and onboarding checklist ready to share on the call.

Thanks — Steph
